description: Accepts or rejects exercise clips cut from your uploads, by ID or all at once. Use when the user approves clips into the library, or discards bad cuts. Not for editing an accepted exercise (use update_exercise_metadata). Returns how many clips changed and any that failed, with reasons. Accepted clips count toward video storage minutes; rejected clips leave the queue for good.

action.description: accept = add the clips to the team library as private exercises; reject = drop them from the review queue.

all_pending.description: true = apply the action to every clip waiting for review in your queue. Use instead of ids.

ids.description: IDs of the clips, 1 to 50. Get them from list_uploads_to_review.

name: review_uploads
title: Review upload clips
